purpose: Discover 30-60 new upstream MLSys/coding task candidates before any new model rollout; this is not a task split or evaluation protocol.

model_freshness_reference.limitation: The model's exact training-data cutoff is unknown. Merge dates after the public training-completion proxy do not prove the model has no relevant knowledge; each shortlisted task needs a blinded freshness probe before evaluation.

discovery.api: GitHub REST pull requests and pull-request changed-file metadata

coarse_screen.meaning: provisional for manual qualification only; not independently graded, reproduced, freshness-qualified, or held out

limitations: Titles and presence of a test path are metadata triage, not independent test execution.
Task-family deduplication, complete changed-file pagination, model freshness, source/test licensing, task extraction, sandbox isolation, and M1 reproduction remain open.
The public upstream PR solution must not be included in agent-visible task material; evaluation must disable network and keep graders separate.
